reviews.text: My pup Diggs loves going to Wag’N Bone for nail trims and daycare! The team there is absolutely phenomenal and are always so kind and caring! Mikayla is wonderful and took such great care of Diggs and his nail trim looked great and Tonie is just the best and makes both Diggs and I feel so welcomed!!!
Mikayla did an incredible job! This was my puppy's first grooming and she took care of him with so much love! I would recommend this place to anyone looking for a grooming spot!
I highly recommend Wag’N Bone! The staff is so friendly and Riley did such a fantastic job with my Pomeranian’s grooming. Thank you so much!

Had the best experience with Wag ‘n Bone! They did such a good job with my little old baby dog. The staff was incredibly friendly and gentle with my pup. I would absolutely recommend their services and can’t wait to bring her back.

Leslie did an amazing job on my Bichon and I highly recommend her! The groom was exactly what I was hoping for, and she looks absolutely adorable. The whole staff was so friendly as well! We will be back!

Sigh…unfortunately this is the second time I have arrived at Wag’n Bone well before closing time and the doors are locked with lights on.

My dog loves the chicken bark treat. Though I live far, for my son’s sake I drive all the way to get a few bags to last a month or two. The hours of operation says Saturday is 9am - 6pm. I arrived 5:09pm and the doors are locked.

From my vehicle I’m calling, just in case someone is in the back and maybe locked the door for safety. No answer.

I think I will do what I’ve always wanted to do, and purchase from the supplier directly. Have it shipped and I won’t have to drive all the way to a store locked an hour before advertised. I’m trying to support a small business but the miles, time and effort is no longer worth it.

I have been bringing my Australian Shepherd here for a couple years now and they’re the best! He’s always done in a timely manner and always looks perfect. I highly recommend Azra but I don’t think you can go wrong here with anyone!
The best!!! Love Azra Greyson and Karyna!

Have been riding my dog here for a while, he is always so excited to come to Wag N Bone, but especially to see Toni! She takes such good care of my sassy boy and always gives great feedback when I pick him up. She’s the reason we keep coming back. And Avi too!
It is so hard to find a groomer you trust these days and Karyna is the best!! She has groomed both of my goldens and is the sweetest. I never have to worry because Swayze looks pertect every time!
My cattle dog DRAGS me to the door every time I bring her. She always has to rush Avi and Toni. We’ve been coming here for 4 years and don’t plan to leave.

Wag N Bone is the best!! The employees are so loving and you can tell they truly care about the animals. Toni and Avi are so great and give Cooper all the love when I bring him in. They always answer all my questions and provide the best customer service! Cooper is always soooo excited to hang with his buddies at WAG. Thanks for taking such great care of Coop.

Love bringing my pup here to daycare! So thankful I can trust the staff especially Toni with my fur baby. It’s also a plus that Lincoln loves Toni too! They have such a great bond and he gets so excited when he sees her working!

Hi, I have been taking my sheepadoodle to Wag'n Bone for almost 3 years. Tonie, Ava, and the entire team have been amazing in taking great care of my little one. He loves playing with the dogs and seeing the workers.

Karyna made my golden retriever Fletcher look so handsome!!!!! It was Fletcher’s first time getting groomed and it turned out better than I expected!! Would definitely recommend Karyna if you have a golden :)

This review is based on their customer service. I have tried to get my dog in for a grooming/bath three times, and each time I have been turned away.

First attempt: I was trying to be proactive and scheduled a bath service ahead of time. Since my puppy was on a vaccine schedule, I figured I’d show proof of vaccines before the actual bath but still have the appointment secured. However, their policy requires vaccine records before booking. Fair, I didn’t disagree with that.

Second attempt: I successfully set up an appointment, but the staff they scheduled me with turned out not to be an actual employee, just a pop-up dental cleaner. Why would that even be an option in their system if they aren’t actual staff? (Also, nothing in the system identified this person as a dental cleaner.) They admitted the mistake and offered to reschedule, but the options were a Friday in the middle of the day or the next Saturday which was in October! I understand policies and limited weekend availability, but the lack of problem-solving from the front desk was frustrating. Their scheduling system is a mess, and their receptionist doesn’t seem to help at all.

Third attempt: I booked a double-coat bath service with some add-on trimming for a Saturday this month. Their system provided the available time slot based on the service I selected. They also already had my dog’s info on file a five-month-old Great Pyrenees mix. Yet I still received a text saying they couldn’t fit me in because the time slot their own system generated wasn’t enough time. Their immediate solution? Reschedule again for over a month away.

I expressed my disappointment and said I did not want to reschedule. Their response? We have to cancel.

Zero solutions. None.

This was clearly their scheduling system’s fault, so why not try to find a way to keep a potential new client? For example, they could have offered to keep my appointment but omit the trimming add-ons. Some type of actual customer service. But no nothing.

Based on my experience and other negative reviews, it seems their receptionist is extremely unprofessional, and the scheduling system is completely unreliable.

We enjoy Wag'N Bone for grooming, especially Karyna! She sends super cute photos after the visit and a little grooming report card, which is a sweet personal touch. She always takes good care of our anxious pup. The folks up front were quick to correct a small pricing mistake during our last visit, which was also very appreciated. They have great customer service and you can tell they love what they do!

I have been bringing my dog to daycare at Wag'n Bone for years and my dog is absolutely obsessed! The staff is so welcoming and accommodating with our pup and she always jumps out of my arms to see her friends! Toni is an absolute gem and always makes sure my dog is loved on and taken care of. She is so organized and responsive and keeps everything running smoothly. You can not beat the one-on-one care provided at Wag'n Bone and we are so happy to have found a place we feel safe leaving our dog and that she looks forward to going to during the week!

My dog LOVES going to see azra and all the girls. She is comfortable getting groomed and i know i can trust them to take care of her when she’s at daycare too. The fact that she’s excited to be there says a lot about how she is treated.

I had such a great experience at Wag N Bone! I just moved into the area from out of state and the two ladies at the front desk were incredibly friendly and welcoming. I recently adopted a dog and they helped me pick out the perfect toys and treats for him and were super knowledgeable and so kind! They explained their grooming and daycare services (i sneaked a peek and so many cuties were there) and made me feel completely at ease. What really stood out was how genuine they were. They offered me a pup cup and even told me to stop by anytime just to say hi and grab a treat while out walking my pup. Highly recommend stopping by!

It’s been a month or so since we have last been here. We had previously been loyal clients before the new ‘Wag n Bone’ name. Whoever the receptionist is at the front is running the business in her own accord turning away, discriminating, and making business decisions for customers.

Greyson was a great groomer and unfortunately we had to leave her due to an ‘incident’ that was perpetrated by the receptionist.

Prior to this we had great rapport with the entire staff, I guess to only find out they (receptionist) labeled us as angry and aggressive on our profile that we were never aware of. Receptionist will gatekeep the phones and won’t let you even access anyone from leadership. Disappointed in this but it led us to a new business.

I had been bringing my dogs to this grooming company for around two years at this point. Unfortunately, I missed an appointment and responded with some understandable frustration when I asked about any work arounds —nothing aggressive, just the kind of thing that can happen in any normal client interaction.

Instead of addressing the moment directly or offering any flexibility, I received an informal termination message stating that our business relationship was over through text, effective immediately. No phone call, no discussion—just a sudden cancellation with vague references to “multiple accounts” that were never previously brought to my attention and never happened.

For a business that claims to value professionalism and mutual respect, this approach was incredibly disappointing and unprofessional. It shows a lack of basic customer service and communication skills. If you’re looking for a grooming company that can handle real-life interactions with understanding and grace, I’d suggest looking elsewhere.
They are great! I love how they groom my baby!
Karyna did a great job grooming our Great Pyrenees mix! He came home with a great haircut and was so soft! A little pricey but he’s a large dog, so it was totally worth it!
We absolutely love this place! Huge thanks to Azra for always providing excellent grooming for Daisy. You’re the best—100% a true professional!🌷 …

Greyson does an amazing job making our girl look and smell great! As a double coated Pyrenees, she is a SHEDDER, but for weeks after her bath and deshedding treatment our house is blissfully (almost) fur free. The calm environment also keeps Buffy happy even though she doesn’t love baths. Thank you, Wag’n Bone!
I felt very welcomed from the moment I walked in! Karyna did an amazing job with Willow!
My dog: Charli and I love the team here! She loves coming here to get groomed. They are so sweet and take such good care of her.

Wag N’ Bone was wonderful! My groomer took pictures during the process of my pup as it was my first time going there and wanted to understand more about their process! We have gotten some bad cuts in our day and she came back perfect! My dog is a cocker spaniel so lots of care goes into her coat maintenance, especially those ears!

Very expensive! They used to do a villager discount that made it somewhat affordable, but without warning that just ended! Over $150 to groom my less than 30 lbs dog. Not worth it, another village amenity ruined :(

Callie and I had an amazing first grooming experience! It was her first time since I rescued her, I was nervous but immediately felt comfortable the moment we arrived. Everyone was super sweet and kind! Karyna did an awesome job, and was very knowledgeable and helpful. Highly recommend taking your pup here!

I love this place! Kind people and great groomers. We always take our sensitive dachshund to Karyna and she’s always so kind to him and he comes out looking so handsome. They have good treats and toys too!
They're great with my dog for grooming, little pricier than other places but my dog always comes out looking great.

They deserve 10 stars! Amazing service! Clean and safe environment. Our Groomer was so knowledgeable, professional, gentle and so kind. Her love and attention to detail is everything and it clearly shows. I am beyond thankful to have found our amazing new Groomer! Thank you Azra and Barkin’ Creek Team.
